_placement_MUST_clip_to_connected_compon: MEASURED 2026-09-19 (shoreline preview + water_derive): a plane sized to the hydro BBOX over-floods, because the bbox contains sub-level terrain outside the lake. D@590.9 reads 98.7 ha over its bbox vs the true connected basin 49.6 ha (2x — the bbox includes the cascade descent below 590.9). A@180 reads 134.8 vs 125.5; B@140 matches (13.6, tight bbox). SO placement must size/shape each water surface to the CONNECTED COMPONENT at the level (flood-fill from centroid = hydro level_slice(lake_id)), not the bbox. A rectangular plane over the connected component's TIGHT extent still shows corner strays where terrain<Z; measure the stray fraction per lake and, if material, use a component-shaped mesh rather than a plane. Positive control: connected-component areas reproduce hydro EXACTLY. Masks saved: _verify/brief4/water_derive_2026-09-19/footprint_{A,B,D}_id*.npy.
